title: Additivity of ANF coefficients
statement: For any two functions $f,g:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$, the coefficient function of their pointwise sum is the pointwise sum of their coefficient functions: for every subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, $\widehat{f+g}(S)=\widehat f(S)+\widehat g(S)$ in $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from the Boolean cube over $\mathbb F_2$ to $\mathbb F_2$
$g$ is a function from the Boolean cube over $\mathbb F_2$ to $\mathbb F_2$
